title: CompleteTaskInput
description: Finish your current task explicitly; the platform pushes your branch first. Use status failed when you cannot finish it.

status.description: platform_error: review/decision tasks only, when the platform did not prepare what you were asked to check (for example the worktree HEAD is not the commit under review). It is not a verdict: the platform prepares the review again.

artifacts.description: Paths, commit SHAs or URLs produced by the task.

handoff.description: Note for whoever builds on this task: what is left, pitfalls, interfaces agreed on. Asked for when other tasks depend on this one.
